language.title: Language
language.desc: Interface language. Device text is never translated.

density.title: Density
density.desc: Compact makes table rows 28 px and controls 26 px.

motion.title: Reduce motion
motion.desc: Replaces springs with quick fades. Follows the system setting by default.

login.title: Open at login
login.desc: Start Tether when you log in to this computer.

title.menuBar: Start hidden in the menu bar

hidden.desc: When opened at login, wait in the background until you need it.

needsTray.menuBar: Turn on the menu bar icon in Notifications first.
needsTray.tray: Turn on the tray icon in Notifications first.

adb.title: adb

which.title: Which adb to use
which.desc: Tether's own copy avoids version fights with Android Studio.

adb.pickFailed: That file is not a working adb
adb.notDownloaded: Tether's copy isn't downloaded yet — use Download above.

server.title: Server
server.confirmText: Every tool on this server (Android Studio, scrcpy) loses its devices for a moment and reconnects. Running transfers are interrupted. The new server starts with the adb selected above.

reconnect.title: Auto-reconnect Wi-Fi devices
reconnect.desc: Try known addresses every 10 s after a drop.

update.bundled: Tether's platform-tools {{version}}. Download the latest from Google any time.
update.notBundled: Get Tether's own copy of platform-tools from Google (~10 MB).
update.consentText: The official archive comes straight from dl.google.com into Tether's folder. Accept Google's license to continue.

how.commands: This adb comes from a package manager. Update it there:
how.studio: This adb is part of the Android SDK. Update “Android SDK Platform-Tools” in Android Studio › SDK Manager, or switch to Tether's copy.
how.manual: Replace this adb with the latest from Google, or switch to Tether's copy, which updates in one click.

captures.title: Screenshots and recordings
captures.desc: Where captures from the device are saved.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.desc: Default folder for files pulled from the device.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Esc cancels, Backspace removes the shortcut.
shortcuts.hintDigits: Press the modifiers with any digit, e.g. ⌥1 or Alt+1. Esc cancels.
shortcuts.conflict: {{keys}} is already used by “{{other}}”. Replace it?

problem.needsModifier: Add ⌘/Ctrl, Alt or Control so typing doesn't trigger it.
problem.reserved: That combination belongs to the system (copy, paste, undo, quit…).
problem.needsDigit: Use a digit 1–9 with modifiers; the digit picks the device.

resetAll.title: Reset all shortcuts
resetAll.desc: Go back to the default keys.

licenses.title: Third-party software
licenses.desc: platform-tools are downloaded from Google under the Android SDK license; screen mirroring uses scrcpy (Apache 2.0).

diagnostics.title: Troubleshooting
diagnostics.desc: Checks the adb server, USB and permissions, and builds a report for issues.

onboarding.title: Welcome screens
onboarding.desc: Walk through finding adb and preparing a phone again.
